content.title: How To Watch Karol G Perform At Coachella: Set Time, Livestream Info And More
content.text: Published April 12, 2026, 3:00 p.m. ET Decider Streamline: 'Beef' Season 2 on Netflix, 'Margo's Got Money Troubles' on Apple TV and More0 seconds of 15 secondsVolume 0% Colombian popstar Karol G will make history this weekend when she takes Coachella stage as the first Latina to headline the music festival in its 27-year run. The “Verano Rosa” singer will perform some of her greatest hits on the Coachella Stage Sunday April 12. “I’m putting the pressure on myself to deliver something at such a high level so people can leave the show and say, ‘Karol was ready. She was more than ready for this,’” she said in an interview with Rolling Stone. “Now it’s on me and my work to deliver that, and I’m so committed to giving the best show ever.” The performance will be the perfect cap on her “Tropicoqueta” era, which borrows heavily from several Latin genres. Rolling Stone also speculated the singer may bring out Kali Uchis, J Balvin or Bad Bunny – some of her most popular collaborators – as special guests. Karol G said being the first Latina headliner sets “a really high bar for the show I need to reach. “I want to deliver something from my heart that represents my love for my community and my fans,” she shared. Coachella Sunday begins at 4 p.m. PDT with performances from Tijuana Panthers, Gigi Perez, Girl Math and Model/Actriz. Rapper Young Thug will also take Coachella Stage ahead of Karol G’s performance. Visit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGEBut if you couldn’t make it to the desert to catch Karol G’s set, here is everything you need to know to livestream Coachella from home. When is Karol G performing at Coachella? Photo: NELSON ALMEIDA / AFP Karol G will be performing at Coachella Sunday, April 12 at 9:55 p.m. PDT. Her set is expected to end around 11:55 p.m. Fans who couldn’t make it to the sold-out festival can tune in from home via the Coachella livestream. Coachella will be live streaming every performance from every single stage this weekend on the Coachella YouTube page and the Coachella app. Some of the performances will be available in 4K. Karol G will take the stage again during the second weekend of Coachella from April 17-19. Tags Karol G YouTube
